QuestInfo.name: The Professional
QuestInfo.0: Use either the #bCrafting Town#k portal in each town or the Profession UI to go to #b#m910001000##k and learn a Profession.
QuestInfo.1: Use either the #bCrafting Town#k portal in each town or the Profession UI to go to #b#m910001000##k and learn a Profession.
QuestInfo.2: You can learn the following Professions: Herbalism, Mining, Smithing, Accessory Crafting, and Alchemy.

0.0: Good to see you. I'm Grant, elder of the crafting town. \n#b#h0##k, how would you like to learn a Profession?

yes.0: Professions let you craft special items through Smithing, Accessory Crafting, and Alchemy skills, using materials obtained through Herbalism and Mining.
yes.1: If you want to learn a Profession, use either a #bCrafting Town#k Portal or the Profession UI's menu to find me in #b#m910001000#.#k You can find the Profession UI's hotkey in Key Bindings, under the System option.

no.0: You can make your own rare items if you do!

1.0: This is #rArdentmill#k, where the masters of all Professions live. Masters of #bHerbalism, Mining, Smithing, Accessory Crafting, and Alchemy#k teach their craft here. Who knows what kinds of Profession masters will appear here in the future?
1.1: Of course, the best way to learn is to practice for yourself. Speak to any of the masters in town to learn more about their craft.

yes.0: I suggest you visit each master and think carefully before you make your decision.
